scope: Frozen post-hoc forensic examination of all seven R18B R windows, no selection or threshold tuning after execution. R18B same decoded 320-wide frame geometry and exact gray SHA. Original R14 score replay; no physical time arrow.

registration.method: For each window estimate frame-to-first-frame affine partial transform via goodFeaturesToTrack, LK, forward-backward error, RANSAC. Exclude candidate radius 24px and fixed possible HUD zones: normalized x<.18,y<.20 OR |x-.5|<.045, |y-.5|<.085; exclude 6% borders. These zones are conservative exclusions, not proof of HUD. Fit uses separate deterministic points (even index) and validate held-out odd index; require >=12 fit inliers, >=8 validation points, validation median residual <=1.5px, inlier fraction >=.6, no excessive scale [.95,1.05], rotation <=5deg, translation<=30px; all 129 frames required for compensated curve, no filling. Reference transforms current->first; raw tracked aperture local mean minus annulus, radii 3/6/10 in 320px grid, signed by prior polarity. Compare fixed screen aperture and moving track aperture, same stabilized photometry at transformed track center; report screen-zone overlap and span, no automatic dismissal solely from position. Three fixed aperture radius sensitivity lanes [2,3,5] with annuli [2r,3r+1]. A compensated window remains candidate only if all 3 raw and stabilized scores R, all frames validated, no possible HUD intersection, no static screen span<=2px; failure is HOLD/NOT_ROBUST, not object identity. No extrapolation from camera registration to 3D speed. Registration controls synthetic textured moving scene with affine translation, and stationary foreground candidate; no ground truth for real tracks.

comparison: Retrieve pinned Zenodo pr135_tracks.csv, pr135_lightcurves.csv, README.md, SHA256SUMS; verify bytes SHA/MD5 against R18A. Inspect column names and README/code for exact frame indexing and source geometry. Compare every PR135 window to published coordinate rows only under explicit verified schema, frame origin and resolution; otherwise report diagnostic nearest for 0/1 index alternatives, no verified match. Same source video, not independent observation. No third-party code executed. Preserve all outcomes.
d165: Public mirrored PDF exact SHA, read page text; adjudicate 8 detections/84s, estimated 55000–70000 ft, 38.5 miles, 1650 mph conditional on single object, 39 degrees after 48s, 12s sweep, no continuous trajectory/identity. Verify source text normalized regex, compute conditional path length/time only, no fabricated points. Preserve discrepant catalog date 7/15/05 vs 2023. Need original radar timestamps, positions, covariance, sensor association. Public mirror is not official byte authentication.
baass: Exact hash PDF; bounded discovery across all pages, report page pointers for radar/radio/clock/measurement topics and explicit DOI/arXiv identifiers. Query DOI metadata via Crossref and arXiv canonical abstract only, max 20 identifiers in deterministic order; compare citation existence, no claim validation from metadata. Technical assertion verification requires linked original measurements; preserve HOLD absent evidence. Store only page hashes, numeric tokens, reference IDs and counts, no personal details. Use public endpoints only.
gates: Exact seven manifest, frame SHA/PTS replay, registration synthetic controls, all seven raw replays, per-window aperture robustness recorded, Zenodo integrity, D165 source assertions verified, BAASS explicit reference search; no gate substitutes for physical evidence. Production unchanged.
